title: The Sound and the Fury
author: William Faulkner
summary: Faulkner tells the decline of the Compson family, a once proud Southern household, in four sections from four viewpoints, beginning with the broken, jumbled thoughts of the youngest son, Benjy.
readIf: you enjoy demanding modernist novels and are willing to reread to piece things together.
skipIf: you want a straightforward, linear story you can read in a relaxed way.
